nom: La Roche-Posay Glycolic B5 Dark Spot Corrector

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the alcohol/glycolic content can feel drying or sticky, though some say it did not dry out their skin and one adds it specifically for winter dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it caused no burning, allergy, or irritation and even worked well, while others report burning, stinging, or drying that made it unsuitable and one linked it to worsening melasma/dark spots.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports it works well, adding moisturizer when feeling dry.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report it does not dry out their skin and note it helped with large pores and oiliness that worsened from mask-wearing.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for age spots and fine lines on hands and face report fading of age spots, softer skin, and lessened fine lines/wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report no drying effect and some describe it as hydrating or radiance-boosting, but a few with dry or sensitive skin found the alcohol content very drying.
concerns.redness: One reviewer notes it does not leave skin red or burning like harsher products she has tried, describing it as gentle by comparison.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer warns to avoid mixing it with other acids to protect the skin barrier and reports good results following that precaution; another reports a burning/tingling reaction after a single use and was unsure whether to continue.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visible lightening or fading of dark spots, sun spots, melasma, age spots, or post-acne marks within one to several weeks; however, several others report no change at all after weeks or months of consistent use, and two report their dark spots or melasma got darker or bumpier.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers using it for acne scars or post-acne dark marks report fading of marks and clearer-looking skin, with one noting it does not clog pores.
concerns.oiliness: Two reviewers with oily skin report the product helped with oiliness and enlarged pores without drying out their skin.

extraits.titre: Do not use on sensitive skin or dark skin.
extraits.texte: It gave me dark spots around my mouth making me look older. I have melisma and this has made it worse and caused more areas to darken.

extraits.titre: Great product, but not for sensitive skin
extraits.texte: I firmly believe in the quality of LaRoche Posay products and that with continued use, users will get their desired results. Unfortunately I was unable to use the product for more than one week as the alcohol in it was incredibly drying for my skin. The consistency is nice, but it has a very strong smell. If you have sensitive or dry skin, you might want to consider using a different product.

This is the La Roche Posay glycolic B5 serum and it helps with brightening and dark spots. I don't struggle with dark spots so I'm not sure how well it works for those, it definitely brightens. It is lightweight and oil free, I add a little to my moisturizer and really like how it helps awaken my skin. It took about 2 weeks of using this that I was able to see a difference in my skin. It has 10% glycolic acid and didn't burn or irritate my sensitive skin
I love this , im combination skin and this works great for me. I add moisturizer for when im feeling more dry.

I have been using this serum for a year. I noticed a much improved look and feel of my skin. I stopped for a short period and returned after noticing my skin dull and had dry dead skin on my face. I would highly recommend this product. My skin is very sensitive and I can use this product.

My skin has improved overall since using this serum at night. I love it! I believe it's even helped with my large pores and oily skin that became an issue with wearing masks all day for covid. I feel like it instantly goes to work as soon as it's applied. It's easy to apply and blend all over the face with the initial dollop unlike other products that absorb rather too quickly before you're able to get a good application, thus having to apply another and another...
I did not get this for dark spots. However, I had a thing under one eye and this got rid of it. It does not dry my skin, but I do have very oily skin and I use it every other day.
